case_study_packaging.headline: Automotive e-commerce retailer unlocks $510K in annual logistics and packaging savings through Treya’s strategic sourcing
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Following a private-equity recapitalization, CJ Pony Parts faced rising shipping, packaging, and labor costs across two distribution centers. Procurement was decentralized and reliant on long-standing incumbents, leaving limited visibility into true spend and few levers to improve margins. With aggressive value-creation targets on the horizon, the company needed a partner to quickly identify and implement meaningful cost reductions while preserving service levels for its fast-growing e-commerce operation.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: Following a private-equity recapitalization, a leading automotive e-commerce retailer faced rising shipping, packaging, and labor costs across two distribution centers. Procurement was decentralized and reliant on long-standing incumbents, leaving limited visibility into true spend and few levers to improve margins. With a focus on operational efficiency and margin improvement, the company needed a partner to quickly identify and implement meaningful cost reductions while preserving service levels for its fast-growing e-commerce operation.
approach_summary: Analyzed 12-month AP and shipment data covering eight direct and indirect categories—$13.6M in addressable spend—to establish clean baselines and savings hypotheses.
Renegotiated the incumbent FedEx small-parcel contract, restructuring rates and surcharges to deliver a 4% reduction worth $339K annually while maintaining carrier continuity.
Ran competitive RFPs and incumbent negotiations for corrugated cartons and packaging supplies, standardizing SKUs across PA and NV facilities and capturing 5% and 32% savings, respectively.
Leveraged OMNIA Partners’ staffing program to secure a 13% markup reduction with Staffmark, projected to save $31K once fully rolled out.
Provided hands-on implementation support—carrier amendment execution, MOU drafting, SKU rationalization, and supplier dashboards—to ensure savings were realized and auditable.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya delivered $510,841 in validated annual savings—more than 6x the engagement’s fixed fee—and has an additional $30,817 in progress, bringing the total to $541K. The results surpassed the original low-end savings estimate of $334K and met the client’s requirement to identify $100K within three months. Beyond the financial impact, Treya standardized packaging specifications, improved supplier payment terms, and equipped leadership with clear savings dashboards for ongoing spend governance.
where_we_were_unique: Identified the first $100K in savings within 90 days, satisfying stringent PE timelines.
Balanced cost reduction with operational continuity by negotiating better terms with incumbents rather than forcing disruptive supplier switches.
Harnessed deep logistics expertise to optimize complex parcel rate structures and surcharges often overlooked by generalist consultants.
Combined GPO access with custom RFP work, unlocking savings across both direct (COGS) and indirect spend categories.
